source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of erythroblastosis foetalis (PDF 95-96).

blocks.text: Erythroblastosis foetalis janeen ya naumolood (newborn) ki haemolytic bimari hai jo Rh-negative hamla maa aur Rh-positive janeen ke darmiyan Rh mutabiqat na hone (incompatibility) se hoti hai.

Yeh tab hota hai jab Rh-negative maa (dd) ke pait mein Rh-positive bachcha (DD ya Dd) ho. Janeen ka khoon maa ke khoon mein ja sakta hai; janeen ke Rh antigens ke saamne aa kar maa anti-Rh antibodies banati hai. Yeh placenta paar kar ke janeen ke khoon mein jati aur us ke red cells tabah karti hain, jis se haemolytic anaemia aur doosri sangeen paicheedgiyan hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: placenta ka kata hua hissa. Umbilical cord chorion se judti hai; janeen ki nalyon wale shakhdar villi maa ke khoon ke hauz (maternal blood pool) mein latakte hain jise maternal arteries aur veins khoon deti hain; hauz ka chhota chaukor neeche bara dikhaya gaya hai. Neeche baen: janeen ke red cells villus se nikal kar maa ke khoon mein jate hain jahan us ke B cells anti-Rh antibodies banate hain. Neeche daen: maa ki anti-Rh antibodies villi aur janeen ke khoon mein dakhil hoti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.6: Erythroblastosis foetalis (kitab ki Figure 18.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Umbilical cord, Chorion, Placenta, Maternal arteries & veins, Maternal blood pool, Foetal RBCs enter into mother's blood, Mother's B cells produce anti-Rh antibodies, Maternal anti-Rh antibodies enter into foetal blood.

items: Shadeed soorat mein janeen ke red cells ki tabahi isqat (miscarriage) ya murda paidaish (stillbirth) ka sabab ban sakti hai.
Agar janeen bach jaye to us ka jigar aur tilli (spleen) zyada red cells banane ki koshish mein bare ho jate hain.
Red cells ke tootne se bilirubin banta hai jo jama ho kar yarqan (jaundice: peeli jild aur aankhein) karta hai; zyada bilirubin dimagh ke cells ko bhi nuqsan de sakta hai.
Bach jane wale bachche ka khoon anti-Rh antibodies se pak Rh-negative khoon se badla jata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: anti-Rh serum se bachao
blocks.text: Jab Rh incompatibility ka imkaan ho to maa ko hamal ke shuru mein aur paidaish ke foran baad Rh antiserum (anti-Rh antibodies wala serum) ka teeka diya jata hai. Yeh maa ke khoon mein aaye bachche ke red cells ko us ke mudafiati nizam ke hassas hone se pehle tabah kar deta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: ABO incompatibility bacha sakti hai
blocks.text: Agar O-negative maa ke pait mein A-positive ya B-positive bachcha ho to maa ke khoon mein aane wale janeen ke red cells us ki pehle se maujood anti-A ya anti-B antibodies jaldi tabah kar deti hain, is se pehle ke woh anti-Rh antibodies bana sake.

blocks.prompt: Rh-negative aurat ki shadi aise Rh-positive mard se hui jis ka baap Rh-negative tha. Mumkina genotypes aur bachche ke mutasir hone ka imkaan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Aurat dd; mard ne apne dd baap se d liya, is liye woh Dd hai; us ki maa DD ya Dd. Har bachche ka 1/2 imkaan Dd (Rh-positive) aur 1/2 dd ka hai. Rh-positive bachche ko khatra tab hai jab maa hassas ho chuki ho, aam taur par pehle aise hamal mein nahi, aur anti-Rh serum is se bacha sakta hai.

items: Rh-negative maa + Rh-positive janeen: maa ki anti-Rh antibodies janeen ke red cells tabah karti hain.
Asraat: anaemia, bara jigar aur tilli, yarqan, dimagh ko mumkina nuqsan, isqat.
Bachao: hamal ke shuru aur paidaish ke foran baad anti-Rh serum.
